newsitem.title: UK: AMEC set to reap 30 mln stg from disposal.
newsitem.headline: AMEC set to reap 30 mln stg from disposal.

text.p: British construction and engineering group AMEC Plc on Wednesday said it was set to make 30 million pounds ($48.51 million) from the sale of its 20 percent stake in Egypt Gas.
The shareholding will be placed with a consortium of institutional investors for 38.1 million pounds cash ($61.61 million).
A net profit of 30 million pounds on completion will be reflected as an exceptional item in AMEC's accounts for the year ending December 1997.
The net proceeds will be used to reduce the group's borrowings, AMEC said in a statement.
The UK group's interest in Egypt Gas was acquired in 1983 to maintain and develop the gas distribution system in Cairo, set up by AMEC in the early 1980's.
In 1995 the shareholding contributed 200,000 pounds ($323,400) in dividends to AMEC's pretax profit. ($1=.6184 Pound)
